purpose: Collapse P4.12 proposal variants only within exact P4.11 source-component identity, compute source-only semantic ranking before representative selection, and refine the representative bbox to nearby non-staff source ink.

steps: Regenerate the frozen P4.11 source-component proposal policy from exact source pixels and frozen v3.2 staff geometry.
Reapply the exact P4.12 source-semantic sieve and require the retained count to equal 7204.
Compute a deterministic source-only semantic score for every retained variant before representative selection.
Group only by exact (staffIndex, componentGroupIndex) identity; do not perform cross-group NMS.
Select the highest-scoring member within each exact source group using deterministic source-only tie breaks.
Refine the selected bbox to nearby connected source ink after horizontal staff-line suppression.
Freeze the full source-group artifact before teacher truth is opened.

semanticScore.importantBoundary: The score is a transparent heuristic ranking signal, not a calibrated C-clef probability and not a detector qualification threshold.

sourceInkRefinement.componentSeed: nearest non-staff connected component to the frozen P4.11 source component-group center
sourceInkRefinement.mergeRule: iteratively include source-ink components whose bbox gap to the current support union is at most 0.55 staff spaces

phaseB.data: already-spent P4.9 teacher truth reclassified for development diagnostic
report: exact source-group count and proposal-collapse fraction
pooled TP/FP/FN/precision/recall/F1 for source-ink refined representatives

stopConditions: Teacher truth is required before the source-group artifact is frozen.
Any new independent holdout is needed to continue implementation.
Any request to reinterpret the semantic score as calibrated probability or qualification evidence.
nextAfterMeasurement: Review group collapse and bbox-refinement diagnostics. Only if the geometry remains recall-safe should a final cross-group precision/ranking policy be preregistered before any new independent holdout is opened.
